name: Overnight drift filter
tagline: Holds TQQQ through the overnight block and the next session, sized by 10-day volatility and halved below the 20-day average.
summary: A close-anchored TQQQ position: at 15:58 it sets exposure to min(1, 0.20/vol10) and halves it when QQQ is below its 20-day SMA, then holds through the night and the following session. Dev earns 44.29% CAGR / 59.71% DD / 1.12 Sharpe, but the frozen full 2016-2026 record reaches 37.07% CAGR / 58.35% DD / 0.97 Sharpe, 0.47 pp short of the bar.
caveat: The full record misses the bar by 0.47 pp because the 2024-2026 holdout earned only about 20.9% CAGR, and the development pass leans on COVID and 2022 crash avoidance; ex-2020 dev CAGR falls to 35.2%, below the bar.
